paragraphs.text:
Running  blindly  through  the  wild  raspberry  whips,  Sylvia 
becomes snared. You are able to catch and subdue her. Norman 
comes up behind you.
Roll 1D10: if the result is even, go to 324; if the result is odd, go to 245.
